images.title: A journey across midnight
images.purpose: Show a journey that leaves at 10:15 p.m. and arrives at 04:00 a.m. the next day, with midnight marked at 24:00 hours and the count going on to 28:00 hours.
images.composition: A caption at the top, a time line across midnight with Today and Next day bands, a hop from the start to the end, and the working written under it.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. TOP LEFT: the caption A train leaves at 10:15 p.m. and the journey takes 5 hours 45 minutes in dark #1F2937 sans-serif bold (34 px), left edge at x 100, about y 70. BANDS: above the line, two words in dark bold (40 px) at about y 215: Today centred at x 300 and Next day centred at x 900. A dashed dark #2B2B2B vertical line (3 px) at x 470 (midnight) from y 250 to y 540. TIME LINE: one thin dark #2B2B2B horizontal line (5 px) at y 400 from x 130 to x 1320, with exactly 8 tall ticks (44 px), one every 170 px, at x 130, 300, 470, 640, 810, 980, 1150, 1320 (one tick for each whole hour from 10:00 p.m. to 05:00 a.m.). LABELS under the ticks, in dark #1F2937 bold (28 px): first row at about y 470: 10:00 p.m. at x 130, 11:00 p.m. at x 300, midnight at x 470, 01:00 a.m. at x 640, 02:00 a.m. at x 810, 03:00 a.m. at x 980, 04:00 a.m. at x 1150, 05:00 a.m. at x 1320; second row at about y 515: 22:00 at x 130, 23:00 at x 300, 24:00 at x 470, 25:00 at x 640, 26:00 at x 810, 27:00 at x 980, 28:00 at x 1150, 29:00 at x 1320 (the count goes on past 24:00 hours: 25:00 to 29:00). START: a reddish purple #CC79A7 dot (26 px) on the line at x 172 with the label 10:15 p.m. start above it at about y 345 (32 px, bold, dark). END: an amber #E69F00 dot (26 px) on the line at x 1150 (the tick 04:00 a.m.) with the label 04:00 a.m. arrive above it at about y 345 (32 px, bold, dark). HOP: one teal blue #0072B2 curved arrow (6 px), the top of an ellipse, from x 172 to x 1150 (978 px wide, 90 px high), arrowhead at the right end landing on the line, with the label 5 hours 45 minutes centred above it at x 661, about y 275 (40 px, bold, dark). BOTTOM: centred at x 728 and about y 650, two lines of bold dark text: 22:15 hours + 5 hours 45 minutes = 28:00 hours, then 28 − 24 = 4, so 04:00 a.m. the next day (40 px). Nothing else in the frame.
labels: A train leaves at 10:15 p.m. and the journey takes 5 hours 45 minutes
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
more or fewer than 8 ticks, labels in the wrong order, or the dashed line anywhere other than the midnight tick
the start dot anywhere other than a quarter of the way from the 10:00 p.m. tick to the 11:00 p.m. tick
images.takeaway: At midnight (24:00 hours) a new day begins: 22:15 hours + 5 hours 45 minutes = 28:00 hours, and 28 − 24 = 4, so the train arrives at 04:00 a.m. the next day.
images.description: A time line from 10:00 p.m. to 05:00 a.m. with midnight marked and a hop from 10:15 p.m. to 04:00 a.m. the next day, with the 24-hour count to 28:00 hours written under it.
images.context: Concept image for Crossing Noon and Midnight. It follows the idea of the 24-hour clock in your maths book (a day ends at 24:00 hours) and shows the concept's own example of a train journey across midnight.
images.teaching_notes: Point at the dashed line: the day ends here and a new day begins. The slip to watch: writing the arrival as 28:00 hours or as 04:00 p.m.

image_decisions.why: The time line across midnight shows where the day ends and why a time above 24:00 hours is in the next day.
